Visual Prompt: A lone figure in a sleek, dark‑blue exosuit with glowing cyan circuit lines strides toward a rusted, metallic fence surrounding an abandoned futuristic facility. Storm clouds swirl overhead, dark and thickening, with distant lightning flickering. The character’s visor reflects the gloomy sky; a handheld scanner on his wrist emits a soft blue pulse as he scans the perimeter. His gauntlet, utility belt, and compact jetpack are visible but inactive. The camera begins with a wide establishing shot from the left, dollying forward to follow his boots as they crunch on broken concrete, then tilts up to reveal the looming facility doors and the gathering storm.
Character Identity & Appearance: Bolt – humanoid android, athletic build, matte‑black exosuit with cyan trim, reflective visor, gauntlet mounted on right forearm, utility belt at waist, jetpack packed on back.
Clothing & Accessories: Exosuit, visor, gauntlet, wrist‑mounted energy scanner, utility belt, jetpack (stowed).
Environment & Props: Rusted outer perimeter fence, broken concrete walkway, distant facility silhouette, storm‑filled sky, scattered debris.
Character Actions: Bolt walks forward, activates his scanner, and conducts a sweep of the area.
Camera Direction & Movement: Slow dolly‑in from left to right, tracking Bolt’s legs, then a slight upward tilt to show the facility and storm; subtle push‑in on the scanner pulse.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Low‑key, cool‑toned lighting from overcast sky; occasional flashes of lightning illuminate the scanner’s blue glow; misty air adds depth.
Continuity: Opening scene – no prior events; Bolt arrives from off‑screen left, exosuit and gear intact, no objects held.
Hindi Dialogue: “स्कैन कर रहा हूँ।”

Storm clouds loom nearer, rain beginning to mist the scene.
